intended_task: Concurrent screening for elevated depressive symptoms using information available before DPQ administration.

outcome.name: elevated_depressive_symptoms
outcome.incomplete_item_policy: Outcome remains missing; no imputation or prorating.

predictor_policy.requirement: Explicit allowlist with codebook and availability review.

availability_review.evidence_as_recorded: Demographic questionnaires administered at home; DPQ administered at MEC.
availability_review.limitation_as_recorded: INDFMPIR is a processed derived value. Retrospective screening assumes its inputs and calculation are available before DPQ; real-time availability is not established.

survey_design.weight_approval: Existing metadata review records WTMEC2YR as the documented DPQ_J component weight. Predictive weighting, uncertainty, and final evaluation approval remain pending.

component_weight_documentation.basis_as_recorded: DPQ_J analytic notes explicitly specify the two-year MEC examination weight.
limitations: Does not resolve selection bias from incomplete DPQ outcomes.
Does not specify the full predictive evaluation or uncertainty procedure.

evaluation.purpose: Exploratory internal predictive evaluation, not temporal validation or national generalizability proof
evaluation.group_rule: Use the pair as one group; no group may cross training and held-out partitions
evaluation.preprocessing: Fit all learned preprocessing within each training fold only
evaluation.predictions: One held-out prediction per eligible participant
evaluation.model_selection: No tuning or threshold selection using held-out performance; estimator specification remains pending
required_checks: Enough distinct groups for five folds
Both outcome classes in every training and held-out partition
Exactly one held-out prediction per eligible participant
evaluation.failure_policy: Stop and review; do not silently change seed or splitting method
limitations: Released design groups do not establish complete household or geographic independence
evaluation.uncertainty: Design-aware uncertainty method pending; fold variability is not a population confidence interval

income.fit_scope: Fit separately within every training fold; never on held-out records
income.all_missing_training_partition: Stop; do not invent a fallback value

missing_data.outcome: Keep incomplete DPQ outcomes missing; no imputation or prorating
missing_data.limitation: Median imputation and a missingness indicator do not establish correction of missing-data bias.

allowed: Read configured local DEMO_J and DPQ_J files
Reconstruct configured eligibility and outcome in memory
Construct proposed grouped folds in memory
Save aggregate feasibility diagnostics and configuration hash
prohibited: Save participant identifiers, outcomes, or fold assignments
Change seed or splitter to obtain a preferred result
split_audit_scope.failure_policy: Report infeasibility; do not silently relax the proposed design

allowed: Read the configured local DEMO_J and DPQ_J files
Reconstruct the configured eligible complete-outcome cohort
Check candidate predictor values and missingness
Reconstruct the proposed grouped folds in memory
Count observed and missing income values in each partition
Check every training partition has observed income
Save aggregate diagnostics, software versions and configuration hash
prohibited: Fit an imputer, scaler, encoder or other learned preprocessing
Fit models or evaluate predictive performance
Save participant identifiers, outcomes or fold assignments
Change the seed or splitter to obtain a preferred result
Approve predictors or freeze the evaluation protocol automatically
predictor_audit_scope.failure_policy: Report failed checks and stop; no automatic fallback

changes: Record the existing component-weight documentation review
Carry forward the derived-income availability limitation
unchanged: Split settings and evaluation approval status
change_log.audit_provenance: Existing passing audit reports apply to their recorded v4/v5 configuration hashes; they are not relabelled as v6 audits.
